metadata.title: CNCF Source Repository — Shared Base Component Definition

components.title: CNCF Source Repository
components.description: Shared software component representing any CNCF source repository.
components.purpose: Define compliance rules for CNCF source repositories.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Early Vulnerability Scanning: Vulnerability and configuration scanning is integrated in the IDE or at the pull request

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Business-Critical Code Testing: Tests are built for business-critical code

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Infrastructure Testing: Tests are built for business-critical infrastructure

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Local Test Execution: Test suites are able to be run locally

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Code Review Requirements: Two non-author reviewers or approvers are required prior to merging

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Code Quality: Code is clean and well commented

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Full Infrastructure Testing: Full infrastructure tests are used

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Regression Testing: Regression tests are used

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Security Regression Testing: Test suites are updated against new and emerging threats and developed into security regression tests

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Threat-Informed Test Development: Threat model results are used to determine ROI for test development

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Static Application Security Testing: Static application security testing (SAST) is performed

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Manifest Scanning: Application manifests are scanned in CI pipeline

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Threat Modeling and Vulnerability Analysis: Threat model code and infrastructure

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Environment and Dependency Validation: Environments and dependencies are validated before usage

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Reproducible Builds: Build artefacts are validated through verifiably reproducible builds

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: External Requirement Verification: External requirements from the build process are locked and verified

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Build Determinism: Sources of non-determinism are found and eliminated

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Build Environment Recording: The build environment is recorded

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Build Environment Automation: Creation of the build environment is automated

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Pipeline as Code: Build and related CI/CD steps are automated through a pipeline delivered as code

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Pipeline Standardization: Pipelines are standardized across projects

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Secured Output Storage: Output is written to a separate secured storage repo

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Pipeline Modification Control: Pipeline modification is only allowed through pipeline as code

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: User Role Definition: User roles are defined

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Root of Trust Establishment: Established practices are followed for establishing a root of trust from an offline source

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Third-Party Artifact Verification: Third party artefacts and open source libraries are verified

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Third-Party SBOM Requirements: SBOM is required from third party suppliers

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Dependency Tracking: Dependencies between open source components are tracked

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Trusted Package Sources: Trusted package managers and repositories are defined and prioritized

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Immutable SBOM Generation: An immutable SBOM of the code is generated

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Software Vulnerability Scanning: Software is scanned for vulnerabilities

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: License Compliance Scanning: Software is scanned for license implications

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Software Composition Analysis: Software composition analysis is run on ingested software

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Commit and Tag Signing: Commits and tags are signed

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Branch Protection Attestation: Full attestation and verification is enforced for protected branches

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Secret Commit Prevention: Secrets are not committed to the source code repository unless encrypted

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Repository Access Definition: Individuals or teams with write access to a repository are defined

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Automated Security Scanning: Software security scanning and testing is automated

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Contribution Policy Enforcement: Contribution policies are established and adhered to

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Functional Role Definition: Roles are defined and aligned to functional responsibilities

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Four-Eyes Principle: An independent four-eyes principle is enforced

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Branch Protection Rules: Branch protection rules are used

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Repository MFA Enforcement: MFA is enforced for accessing source code repositories

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Key Rotation Policy: A key rotation policy is maintained

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Secure Configuration Defaults: Secure configuration is implemented as the default state of the system

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Supply Chain Security Best Practices: Supply chain security best practices are adhered to

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Repository and Branch Access Control: Access to repository and branches is restricted

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Git Secret Prevention: Unencrypted credentials or secrets are never stored in the Git repository and sensitive data is blocked from being pushed

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Commit Identity Enforcement: Strong identity is enforced with GPG Signed Commits for accountability and traceability

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Linear History Enforcement: Linear history is required and commit history is maintained by disallowing force pushes

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Branching Policy Enforcement: Branching policy is enforced with main branch protection and code review required before merging

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Git Tool Security Monitoring: Vulnerabilities are monitored and Git and GitOps tools are kept up to date

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Privilege Escalation Prevention: Users who can elevate permissions to remove security features are limited to prevent deletion of audit trails and silencing of alerts

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Early Vulnerability Scanning: Integrate vulnerability and configuration scanning in both the IDE and at the CI system during pull request

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Code Review Requirements: Implement at least one other non-author reviewer/approver prior to merging

components.title: Privateer validation
components.description: Checks provided by Privateer (pvtr) itself: its github-repo plugin evaluates the OpenSSF Open Source Project Security Baseline (OSPS) for a GitHub repository. Each control has its own OSPS requirement.
components.purpose: Validate CNCF controls using OSPS Baseline requirement results from Privateer.

components.title: Privateer plug-in validation
components.description: Checks provided by the cncf-controls Privateer plugin written for this project (privateer-plugins/cncf-controls), which evaluates the CNCF MUST controls the OSPS Baseline does not cover. It runs alongside github-repo in the same pvtr run.
components.purpose: Validate the CNCF MUST controls using requirement results from the cncf-controls plugin.

components.title: No-check validation
components.description: Controls that are in scope for repository assessment but have no unique Privateer check (no-check). They are reported as not determined and never count as a pass. The reason for each is in docs/privateer-check-coverage.md.
components.purpose: Record in-scope controls that are not yet automatically assessed.

components.title: Skip validation
components.description: Controls that are out of scope for static source repository assessments (skip). They are excluded from scoring.
components.purpose: Record controls that are intentionally not assessed.
